events.label: Labor returns
events.text: Daniel Andrews becomes Premier. The government is re-elected in November 2018 and November 2022.

events.label: Reform becomes a service
events.text: The voluntary assisted dying law passes in 2017 on a conscience vote and begins operating in June 2019. Free TAFE starts in 2019.

events.label: Pandemic failures examined
events.text: The hotel quarantine inquiry and the Ombudsman’s public housing tower report both land in December, on events from the same year.

events.label: Operation Watts reports
events.text: IBAC and the Ombudsman substantiate misuse of public resources for factional purposes. Conduct examined runs back several years.

events.label: Free Kinder and the regional fare cap
events.text: Free Kinder starts with the school year; regional daily fares are capped at the metropolitan fare from 31 March. The Heart Hospital opens in February.

events.label: Commonwealth Games cancelled
events.text: The government withdraws from hosting the 2026 Games. The Auditor-General’s assessment arrives eight months later.

events.label: Jacinta Allan becomes Premier
events.text: Andrews resigns; Allan takes over on 27 September. The Ombudsman’s politicisation report follows in December.

events.label: The Games bill is assessed
events.text: VAGO puts the cost of not hosting at more than $589 million and finds the business case understated costs.

events.label: The levy proposal is cut, then frozen
events.text: The proposed farm rate drops from 83 to 71.8 cents on 15 May; on 30 May it is held at the old 28.7 cents for 2025–26 as drought relief.

events.label: The new levy starts
events.text: The Emergency Services and Volunteers Fund levy replaces the Fire Services Property Levy on 1 July.

events.label: Metro Tunnel and Treaty
events.text: Metro Tunnel opens on 30 November after a decade of construction; the West Gate Tunnel follows on 14 December; statewide Treaty commences on 12 December.

events.label: The Watson review of the CFMEU surfaces
events.text: A review for the union’s administrator documents corruption on construction sites and government inaction. Its $15 billion cost figure is an untested estimate.

events.label: Allan resigns; Carroll takes over
events.text: Allan resigns ahead of an expected spill, amid the construction-integrity crisis and poor polling. Carroll is elected unanimously and announces a royal commission on his first day.

events.label: Operation Richmond reports on 2016
events.text: IBAC finds Andrews and senior officials bypassed proper process in the firefighters’ union negotiations. No corrupt-conduct finding; the blackmail allegation is not substantiated.

events.label: Construction royal commission established
events.text: Former South Australian chief justice Christopher Kourakis is appointed; the commission reports in August 2027, after the election.

events.label: SRL trimmed; fare levy scrapped; roads money added
events.text: The SRL review claims $1 billion in savings the Auditor-General says were never in the estimate; an undisclosed 1% fare levy is abolished; $352 million is added for roads.

events.label: The roads audit lands
events.text: VAGO finds almost half of state roads poor or very poor for remaining life, on 2024 survey data.

events.label: The next decision
events.text: Victorians vote. Early voting runs from 18 November.
